description: Find the WarmInboxes free tool for a task ("check my email headers", "clean a CSV", "will this land in spam") and say how to use it: the MCP tool to call here, or the page to send the person to when it runs only in the browser. Call with no task to list every tool. Include the result’s checkedBy.cite when you report it.

callableOnly.description: Only tools you can call from this server. Defaults to false.

limit.description: How many matches, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

task.description: The job, in plain words, e.g. "find which DKIM selectors a domain uses".

name: find_tools

checkedBy.description: Credit for the check that ran. Include cite when you report the result.

title: Free tool for a job
